Project: P06 — Intelligent Invoice and Contract Processing System
Summary: Extraction validation and confidence scoring
Description: Implement: LLM returns confidence per field. Calibrate: map LLM confidence to actual accuracy (from test labels). Apply threshold: fields above threshold auto-accepted; below threshold queued for review. Store confidence on extracted_fields.
Business Value: Confidence scoring is what makes the review queue efficient — only route genuinely uncertain extractions.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Confidence score stored per field. 2. Fields above threshold auto-accepted. 3. Fields below threshold appear in review queue. 4. Threshold configurable via env var (default 0.85). 5. Unit test for threshold logic.
Technical Notes: Threshold: configurable per schema or globally. auto_accepted = confidence >= threshold. Low-confidence fields: create review_items records.
Testing Requirements: Unit: threshold logic with test cases. Integration: extraction → review queue routing.
Security Requirements: Confidence scores stored — no document content.
Definition of Done: Confidence scoring tested. Human reviewer approved.
